newsitem.title: UK: Wool market focus on Bradford.
newsitem.headline: Wool market focus on Bradford.

text.p: This week's British wool auction in Bradford will attract more than the usual amount of interest, brokers said.
The absence of a significant auction test of wool values anywhere else in the world until Australia gets under way again next week left Bradford as the main focus of attention for the wool trade.

Also, there may be some covering interest at the auction following recent talk of British woool sales to China. But brokers said they did not anticipate any sharp rise in prices as the U.K. trade is sensitive to the fact that sterling's strength has made their market vulnerable to overseas competition.
